description: Exact port of nera-data-layer schema_bootstrap_contracts at 2b1504adc4291daaf080b2e932962b134da1a69a.

stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,NULL AS alias,NULL AS module,NULL AS value,NULL AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(ast_breadth_order,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(ast_index,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(ast_end,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,NULL AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,NULL AS context,NULL AS name_repr,NULL AS value_repr,NULL AS annotation,NULL AS annotation_repr FROM canonical

stages.name: calls
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.name AS callee,f.id AS callee_id,r.id AS receiver,r.kind AS receiver_kind,r.name AS receiver_name
      FROM a c JOIN a f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.parent=c.id AND f.field='func'
      LEFT JOIN a r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.parent=f.id AND r.field='value'
      WHERE c.kind='Call'

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: parameters
stages.query: SELECT p.* FROM a p JOIN a arguments ON arguments.__path=p.__path AND arguments.id=p.parent AND arguments.kind='arguments' JOIN functions f ON f.__path=arguments.__path AND f.id=arguments.parent WHERE p.kind='arg'

stages.name: decorators
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE d(__path,fn,root,id) AS (
      SELECT __path,parent,id,id FROM a WHERE field='decorator_list'
      UNION ALL SELECT d.__path,d.fn,d.root,n.id FROM d JOIN a n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.parent=d.id AND n.field='func'
      JOIN a c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.id AND c.kind='Call')
      SELECT d.__path,d.fn,d.root,n.id,n.kind,n.name FROM d JOIN a n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.id WHERE n.kind IN ('Name','Attribute')

stages.name: annotation_names
stages.query: SELECT __path,CAST(annotation AS INTEGER) AS annotation,name FROM raw_annotation_names

stages.name: params
stages.query:
SELECT p.*,v.id AS annotation_id,f.name AS function_name,f.name_repr AS function_repr,
 CASE p.field WHEN 'posonlyargs' THEN 0 WHEN 'args' THEN 1 WHEN 'kwonlyargs' THEN 2 WHEN 'vararg' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END*10000+p.position AS param_order
 FROM parameters p JOIN functions f ON f.__path=p.__path AND f.id=p.fn
 LEFT JOIN a v ON v.__path=p.__path AND v.parent=p.id AND v.field='annotation' WHERE p.kind='arg'

stages.name: param_types
stages.query: SELECT p.__path,p.id,n.name FROM params p JOIN annotation_names n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.annotation=p.annotation_id

stages.name: function_annotations
stages.query:
SELECT p.__path,p.fn,v.id AS annotation,0 AS category,p.param_order AS ordinal FROM params p JOIN a v ON v.__path=p.__path AND v.id=p.annotation_id
 UNION ALL SELECT v.__path,v.parent,v.id,1,0 FROM a v WHERE v.field='returns'
 UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id,v.id,2,n.bfs FROM functions f JOIN a n ON n.__path=f.__path AND n.id BETWEEN f.id AND f.last AND n.kind='AnnAssign' JOIN a v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id AND v.field='annotation'

stages.name: forbidden_annotations
stages.query: SELECT x.__path,x.fn,x.annotation,x.category,x.ordinal,group_concat(n.name,', ') AS names FROM function_annotations x JOIN annotation_names n ON n.__path=x.__path AND n.annotation=x.annotation WHERE n.name IN ('AsyncDatabaseConnection','AsyncReadTransaction','AsyncSchemaTransaction','AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection','AsyncWriteTransaction','SyncDatabaseConnection','SyncReadTransaction','SyncSchemaTransaction','SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection','SyncWriteTransaction') GROUP BY x.__path,x.fn,x.annotation,x.category,x.ordinal

stages.name: broad_params
stages.query: SELECT p.__path,p.id,group_concat(t.name,', ') AS names FROM params p JOIN param_types t ON t.__path=p.__path AND t.id=p.id WHERE t.name IN ('Any','Collection','Iterable','Mapping','MutableMapping','MutableSequence','Sequence') GROUP BY p.__path,p.id

stages.name: schema_params
stages.query: SELECT p.__path,p.id,group_concat(t.name,', ') AS names FROM params p JOIN param_types t ON t.__path=p.__path AND t.id=p.id WHERE t.name IN ('AsyncSchemaTransaction','SyncSchemaTransaction') GROUP BY p.__path,p.id

stages.name: readonly_params
stages.query:
SELECT p.__path,p.id FROM params p JOIN a ann ON ann.__path=p.__path AND ann.id=p.annotation_id AND ann.kind='Subscript'
 JOIN a root ON root.__path=ann.__path AND root.parent=ann.id AND root.field='value'
 JOIN a element ON element.__path=ann.__path AND element.parent=ann.id AND element.field='slice'
 WHERE substr(p.function_name,1,1)!='_' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a n WHERE n.__path=root.__path AND n.id BETWEEN root.id AND root.last AND n.kind IN ('Name','Attribute') AND n.name='Sequence')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a n WHERE n.__path=root.__path AND n.id BETWEEN root.id AND root.last AND n.kind IN ('Name','Attribute') AND n.name!='Sequence')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM annotation_names n WHERE n.__path=element.__path AND n.annotation=element.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM annotation_names n WHERE n.__path=element.__path AND n.annotation=element.id AND n.name IN ('Any','bytes','bytearray','float','int','object','str'))
